evidence.location: Entire current report, all experiment/allocation tables, Appendices A–B; cited original methods and results described in basis
evidence.basis: I read the complete current 72,677-character English manuscript in four contiguous bounded ranges, including the source/version appendices and every allocation table. I reused my actual earlier independent U1 reading of TTC001–008 and examined the whole-report claims against their relevant originals. The manuscript retains trained verifier/revision prerequisites and the excluded 2,048-sample difficulty estimation in TTC001; s1 training and inference choices are distinguished. The TTC003v2 shared-bank comparison preserves 120 questions, 80 responses and the reference-answer verifier as a diagnostic, with the total-response/released-attempt inventory distinction. TTSP is identified as parameter adaptation with execution feedback and a 28-question selected population; TTC006 contradictory numerical protocol is not used to infer a threshold; TTC007 remains a finite empirical oracle, not an online controller result. Original TTC009 methods and tables confirm PaLM-540B temperature .7/top-k40, forty sampled paths in each of ten runs, and GSM8K56.5 versus74.4. TTC010 section4.1 explicitly supports the roughly100-sample selector saturation for the tested Llama3/ArmoRM setup, distinct from 10,000-sample coverage; the abstract uses broader wording but the report matches the body. TTC011 table2 preserves ToT74%, CoT4%, CoT-SC1009% and oracle best-of10049%; the writing study is a blinded author comparison of100 pairs,41/21/38, not general research quality. TTC012 figure3/methods confirm PRM78.2/ORM72.4/vote69.6 with1,860 candidates on500 held-out MATH questions, product aggregation, and the large-model training comparison limitation. I reused the original SCoRe methods/results inspected for the separately authored VSI task: MATH base52.6→41.4 versus trained60→64.4, and the distinct coding model/split. CodeMonkeys original section/table1 confirms69.8 coverage,57.4 selected,45.8 random, total historical LLM cost2291.90USD/500 and selection131.95USD. The report does not turn these into current total service prices. Adaptive-Consistency original stopping derivation supports the top-two Beta approximation, whose vote concentration is not truth. Tree Search for LM Agents methods/limitations support matched five-action settings and reset-and-replay rather than harmless real-world reversal. Original Inference Scaling Flaws sections3–4 use base tests for filtering and expanded tests for evaluation; its false-positive utility varies by task and loss. Intrinsic Self-Correction sections3.1/3.3 retain historical models, feedback prompts and correct-to-wrong transitions, rather than a universal ban on revision. I inspected the already executed allocation_example.py and retained JSON, without rerunning: all twelve cost/candidate rows, four-worker waves and the deadline scenario use the stated uniform-among-accepted independent-candidate model. At budget32, stronger generation plus better verification uses6 candidates with95.40% correct/2.12% wrong and110s; the100s constraint changes it to4 candidates,20credits and55s with89.51%/1.99%. The scope and loss assumptions are explicit. Citations point to identifiable publication versions; observed results, author calculations and deployment recommendations remain distinguishable. No required evidence correction was found. This is a review of the complete report and consequential original sections, not a claim that every appendix or implementation was reproduced.
